name: AA Badenhorst Family Wines
famous_for: Chenin Blanc; Syrah; Grenache; old-vine blends
about: Adi Badenhorst's pioneering estate on Kalmoesfontein farm in the Paardeberg, a founding force of the Swartland Revolution. Produces old-vine Chenin Blanc, Rhône-style reds and the cult Secateurs range.

name: Sadie Family Wines
about: Eben Sadie's revered Swartland cellar, producing some of South Africa's most sought-after wines including the iconic Columella red blend. The flagship reference point of the Swartland Revolution.

name: Mullineux & Leeu Family Wines
about: Chris and Andrea Mullineux's acclaimed Roundstone Farm estate, partnered with Analjit Singh's Leeu Collection. Platter's Winery of the Year 2016, known for terroir-driven Syrah and old-vine Chenin Blanc.

name: David & Nadia Sadie
about: Husband-and-wife team David and Nadia Sadie making artisanal, terroir-expressive wines from the Paardeberg. First-generation winemakers celebrated for single-vineyard Chenin Blanc and Syrah.

name: Rall Wines
famous_for: Noa Chenin Blanc; Syrah; white blends
about: Donovan Rall's garagiste label and one of the original Swartland Revolution producers. Boutique micro-production celebrated for the Noa Chenin Blanc and Rhône-style whites and reds.

name: Porseleinberg
about: A 173-hectare farm atop the Porseleinberg ridge acquired by Boekenhoutskloof in 2009. Produces a celebrated single-vineyard Syrah from decomposed schist soils under winemaker Callie Louw.

name: Testalonga
famous_for: natural Chenin Blanc; skin-contact whites; El Bandito
about: Craig and Carla Hawkins' natural and low-intervention Swartland cellar, renowned for skin-contact Chenin Blanc, the El Bandillo range and minimalist Rhône reds.

name: Intellego Wines
about: Jurgen Gouws' boutique natural-wine label in the Swartland, making expressive Chenin Blanc, skin-contact whites and Rhône reds with minimal intervention.

name: The Blacksmith Wines
about: Tremayne Smith's own Swartland venture focused on Paardeberg fruit and field blends. A Swartland Independent Producers member celebrated for inventive, minimal-intervention wines.

name: Wolf & Woman Wines
about: Jolandie Fouché's Swartland label sourcing from old, dryland-farmed vineyards. Swartland Independent Producers member producing graceful Chenin Blanc and Cinsault-based wines.

name: Yellowwood Winery
about: Alan Cooke's small Swartland cellar and Swartland Independent Producers member, making small-batch wines from old-vine Swartland fruit.

name: Tim Hillock Wines
about: Tim Hillock's solo Swartland label and Swartland Independent Producers member, crafting old-vine Chenin Blanc and Mediterranean varieties with a light touch.

name: Dragonridge Winery
about: Johan and Diana Simons' garagiste cellar on Fynbos Estate deep in the Paardeberg, where 15 ha of vineyards adjoin a 270 ha nature reserve. Natural-style, some certified organic wines.

name: City on a Hill
about: Andre Bruyns' Swartland micro-winery and Swartland Independent Producers member, crafting terroir-driven Chenin Blanc, Syrah and Pinotage in small batches.

name: Fram Wines
about: Thinus Krüger's Swartland label and Swartland Independent Producers member, focused on old-vine Chenin Blanc and Mediterranean varieties.

name: Hofstraat Wine Co
about: Wim Smit's small Swartland label and Swartland Independent Producers member, producing minimal-intervention old-vine Chenin Blanc and Syrah.

name: Huis van Chevallerie
about: Christa Von La Chevallerie's Swartland label and Swartland Independent Producers member, focused on Rhône-style red and white blends from old vines.

name: JC Wickens Wines
about: Jasper Wickens' Swartland micro-cellar and Swartland Independent Producers member, producing small-batch Chenin Blanc, Pinotage and Syrah.

name: JH Meyer / Mother Rock
about: Johan Meyer's Swartland labels and Swartland Independent Producers member, known for natural, low-sulphur Mother Rock Chenin Blanc and other old-vine expressions.

name: Wightman & Sons Wine Co
about: Andrew Wightman's family Swartland label and Swartland Independent Producers member, making small-batch wines from old Swartland vines.

name: Lammershoek
about: One of the historic Swartland estates central to the early revolution, with old vines planted on granitic soils. Now under Jorrie du Plessis, making Rhône-style blends and old-vine Chenin Blanc.

name: Alheit Vineyards
famous_for: Cartology; Nautical Dawn; old-vine Chenin Blanc
about: Chris and Suzaan Alheit's celebrated label sourcing old-vine Chenin Blanc and Semillon across the Cape. Cartology is one of South Africa's most iconic white blends.

name: Boekenhoutskloof
about: Marc Kent's acclaimed winery, sourcing significant Swartland fruit and owning the Porseleinberg estate. The Chocolate Block blend is among South Africa's most famous reds.

name: Riebeek Valley Wine Co
about: One of the oldest authentic WO Swartland producers, a co-operative of around 30 shareholders cultivating some 900 ha. Known for honest, region-typical Chenin Blanc and Pinotage.

name: Kloovenburg Wine & Olive Estate
about: The oldest registered property in the Swartland, run by the du Toit family since 1956. Produces a classic Swartland Shiraz and Pinotage alongside a renowned olive range.

name: Allesverloren Wine Estate
about: The oldest wine estate on the Swartland wine route, with the Malan family at the helm since 1872. Celebrated for its structured Shiraz, Portuguese varieties and fortified wines.

name: Org de Rac
about: Pioneer of certified organic wine farming in South Africa, founded by Nico Bacon near Piketberg. Produces estate-grown organic Sauvignon Blanc, Shiraz and other Mediterranean varieties.

name: Swartland Winery
about: Founded in 1948 in Malmesbury by 15 member farmers, one of the largest co-operatives in the region. Produces widely-distributed, value-driven WO Swartland wines.

name: Leeu Estates
famous_for: Leeu Passant blends; Mullineux partnership wines
about: Analjit Singh's luxury Leeu Collection estate in Franschhoek with vineyards in the Swartland, partnered with Mullineux. Home to the Leeu Passant label, fine dining and a luxury hotel.

name: Thor Vintners
about: A newer Swartland small-batch producer specialising in ultra-premium Rhône-style blends and carbonic Shiraz. Operates primarily through an online wine-club model.

name: Fynbos Estate
about: A serene Paardeberg sanctuary home to Dragonridge Winery, combining 15 ha of vineyards with a 270 ha nature reserve. Wines are made naturally with no pesticides or herbicides.

name: Eenzaamheid
about: A historic Paardeberg farm that supplies old-vine Chenin Blanc and Mourvèdre to several leading Swartland producers. Source vineyard for several cult single-vineyard bottlings.

name: Windmeul Kelders
about: A long-standing Swartland co-operative cellar near Paarl producing accessible, value-driven Chenin Blanc, Pinotage and blended wines.

name: Welbedacht Estate
about: A boutique family estate on the eastern Swartland border producing estate-grown Cabernet Sauvignon and Chenin Blanc, with a popular farm restaurant.

name: Napier Winery
about: A small Swartland-focused negociant label sourcing from old, dry-farmed vineyards to make limited-release Chenin Blanc and Syrah.

name: Meerhof Wine Co
about: A smaller Swartland-based cellar producing accessible everyday table wines from co-operative Swartland fruit.

name: Saxenburg
about: A producer with holdings sourcing Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon fruit from the warmer Swartland pockets for full-bodied red wines.

name: Wildepaardekloof
about: A Swartland farm cellar producing fresh, early-drinking Chenin Blanc and Colombard from the region's warm, dry vineyards.

name: Babylonstoren (Saxenburg link)
about: A Paardeberg source vineyard supplying Grenache and Chenin Blanc fruit to multiple Swartland independent producers.

name: Porseleinkloof Vineyards
about: A schist-soil vineyard source on the Porseleinberg ridge supplying premium Syrah and Chenin Blanc fruit to leading negociant producers.

name: Hamilton Russell Vineyards
about: South Africa's pioneering cool-climate estate, founded by Tim Hamilton Russell in 1975. Produces the country's benchmark Pinot Noir and Chardonnay under Anthony Hamilton Russell.

name: Bouchard Finlayson
famous_for: Pinot Noir; Galpin Peak Pinot Noir; Chardonnay
about: Established in 1989 as a partnership between Burgundian Paul Bouchard and Peter Finlayson, the pioneer of Hemel-en-Aarde Pinot Noir. Renowned for Galpin Peak Pinot Noir.

name: Newton Johnson Family Vineyards
about: The Newton Johnson family's Upper Hemel-en-Aarde estate, founded in 1995 and celebrated for site-specific Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. The family restaurant is a valley favourite.

name: Creation Wines
famous_for: Pinot Noir; Chardonnay; wine and food pairings
about: Founded in 2002 by JC and Carolyn Martin on the Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge. One of the valley's leading estates, renowned for a wide range of cool-climate wines and acclaimed food pairings.

name: Southern Right
about: Founded by Anthony Hamilton Russell in 1994 to produce a serious, age-worthy Pinotage. Named after the Southern Right whales that frequent Walker Bay.

name: Ataraxia
about: Kevin and Hanli Grant's Skyfields Farm estate on the Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge, founded 2004. Produces elegant Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and the flagship Serenity blend.

name: Restless River
famous_for: Cabernet Sauvignon; Chardonnay; Main Road Blend
about: The Wessels family's Upper Hemel-en-Aarde estate with vines dating to 1998. The label launched in 2012, producing acclaimed Chardonnay and some of the valley's oldest Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Storm Wines
about: Hannes and Nathalia Storm's estate, founded 2008 after Hannes spent 12 vintages at Hamilton Russell. Produces highly regarded single-vineyard Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

name: Domaine des Dieux
about: A boutique estate on the foothills of the Babylonstoren mountain, founded 2002 by Sharon Parnell and Peter Clarke. One of the early producers of Hemel-en-Aarde Cap Classique.

name: Spookfontein
about: A 313-hectare farm named after a local 'ghost spring' legend, dating to 1847 and developed into a modern boutique winery on the Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge.

name: La Vierge
about: A dramatic hillside estate on the Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge producing Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Cap Classique, with a popular restaurant and striking architecture.

name: Whalehaven / Idiom
about: Whalehaven, one of the earlier Hermanus cellars, is part of the Idiom family producing Whalehaven Pinot Noir alongside Idiom's Italian-variety blends on the hills above Sir Lowry's Pass.

name: Hermanuspietersfontein
about: A Walker Bay cellar named after the founding father of Hermanus, known for its Sauvignon Blanc and Bordeaux-style blends under the late Bartho Eksteen. Tasting room at Die plaaskombuis.

name: Bosman Hermanus
about: A Bosman Family Vineyards tasting venue in the Hemel-en-Aarde Valley offering Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and a relaxed platter experience.

name: Cap Maritime
about: A small Hemel-en-Aarde-focused label producing cool-climate Chenin Blanc and Pinot Noir from valley fruit.

name: Hasher Family Wines (ex-Sumaridge)
about: The estate formerly known as Sumaridge on the Upper Hemel-en-Aarde Valley, now rebranded as Hasher Family Wines with the Epoche restaurant on site.

name: Moya's Vineyard
about: A small boutique Hemel-en-Aarde label producing limited Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from valley vineyards.

name: Mount Babylon
about: A low-intervention Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge label crafting natural Pinot Noir, Riesling and aromatic whites from cool-climate fruit.

name: Jakob's Vineyards
about: A small family vineyard on the Hemel-en-Aarde Valley producing handcrafted Pinot Noir and Chardonnay in tiny quantities.

name: 7 Springs Vineyards
about: A boutique Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge estate producing elegant Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Syrah from cool-climate vineyards.

name: Valley Cru
about: A collective cellar at Hemel-en-Aarde village hosting five independent winemakers, offering shared tastings of their small-batch wines.

name: Hemelrand Alheit / Hemelrand
about: A celebrated Hemel-en-Aarde Ridge vineyard source, most famously bottled as Hemelrand by Alheit Vineyards for an acclaimed old-vine white blend.

name: Benguela Cove Lagoon Wine Estate
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Pinot Noir; estate dining
about: A modern estate on the Bot River Lagoon along the R43, producing Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir with a striking tasting room and restaurant.

name: Springfontein Wine Estate
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Chenin Blanc; Pinot Noir
about: A Stanford estate founded by German vintner Johst Weber, with farm roots traced to 1816. Produces terroir-driven limestone-influenced wines including acclaimed Sauvignon Blanc.

name: Raka Wine
about: The Dreyer family's Stanford estate named after a fishing boat, with first vineyards planted in 1999. One of the pioneers of the Stanford wine route, known for its Bordeaux blends.

name: Boschrivier Wines
about: One of the older wine farms in the Walker Bay area, with a historic homestead dating to the 1890s. Produces estate-grown Shiraz and Pinot Noir near Stanford.

name: Walker Bay Estate
about: A Stanford estate that planted its first vines in 2003 and is also home to Birkenhead Brewery. Produces Walker Bay Vineyards wines and popular craft beer.

name: Maanschijn
about: An artisanal low-intervention winery founded in 2017 by Douglas Mylrea and Paul Hoogwerf near Stanford. Celebrated for natural Chenin Blanc and experimental skin-contact wines.

name: Brunia Vineyards
about: A cool-climate project owned by the Sander family in Sondagskloof near Stanford, with Sauvignon Blanc first planted in 2005.

name: Vaalvlei Winery
about: The Terblanche family's small 3-hectare estate on the Stanford wine route, a hidden gem producing limited handcrafted wines.

name: Stanford Hills / Jacksons
about: A boutique Stanford estate and the home of the Jacksons wine label, producing Pinotage and Chenin Blanc with a popular tasting room and restaurant.

name: Landskein (Sir Robert Stanford Estate)
famous_for: Chenin Blanc; Sauvignon Blanc; Zesty Lemon
about: A historic estate named after Sir Robert Stanford, now home to the Landskein label and the Zesty Lemon restaurant in Stanford.

name: Welgesind Cellars
about: A small Stanford family cellar producing limited-release boutique wines from local Walker Bay fruit.

name: Deep Rooted Wines
about: A Stanford-area micro-producer sourcing old-vine Chenin Blanc and crafting minimal-intervention, terroir-focused wines.

name: Baardskeerdersbos Vineyards
about: A tiny producer near the hamlet of Baardskeerdersbos, producing small-batch cool-climate wines from the southern Overberg.

name: Constantia Glen
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Bordeaux blends; cool-climate reds
about: An award-winning boutique cool-climate estate high on Constantia Nek, producing acclaimed Sauvignon Blanc and a Bordeaux-style red blend with relaxed tasting and dining.

name: Eagles' Nest
about: A family-run estate in a secluded Constantia valley, re-established as a wine farm after a 1999 fire. Known for Viognier, Sauvignon Blanc and elegant Merlot.

name: Constantia Uitsig
about: A historic part of the original 1685 Constantia land grant, re-established as a wine estate. Produces elegant Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon and Cap Classique alongside two restaurants.

name: Beau Constantia
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Semillon; Cecily red blend
about: A modern high-altitude Constantia estate with panoramic views, producing Sauvignon Blanc, Semillon and the flagship Cecily red blend with a glass tasting room and restaurant.

name: Silvermist Vineyards
about: An organic Constantia estate on the slopes of Constantia Nek, producing certified-organic Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and red blends with sweeping views over the Cape.

name: De Grendel
about: The Graaff family's estate on Tygerberg Hill with views to the sea, one of Durbanville's flagship cellars. Known for Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir and an acclaimed restaurant.

name: Klein Roosboom
about: A family-run boutique Durbanville cellar known for handcrafted small-volume reds and whites, including a popular Merlot. Offers tastings in its underground cellar.

name: D'Aria
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Pinot Grigio; Italian varieties
about: A modern Durbanville estate with Italianate styling, producing Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Grigio and Mediterranean varieties, with a popular restaurant and function venue.

name: Canto Wines
about: A smaller Durbanville cellar producing limited-volume Sauvignon Blanc and reds from Durbanville valley fruit.

name: Maastricht
about: A family-run Durbanville estate producing typical cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc and Cap Classique, with a relaxed tasting room.

name: Altydgedacht
about: One of the oldest farms in the Durbanville valley, dating to 1698 and run by the Parker family. Produces Pinotage, wooded Chenin Blanc and rare dessert wines.

name: Groot Phesantekraal
about: A historic Durbanville farm dating to 1698, run by the Brink family. Produces cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc, Rhine Riesling and Cap Classique with a popular restaurant.

name: Hillcrest Estate
about: A boutique Durbanville estate in the Tygerberg Hills producing Sauvignon Blanc and red blends, with a well-regarded restaurant and rustic farm setting.

name: L'Avenir
about: A small Durbanville-focused label producing limited boutique Chenin Blanc and reds from valley vineyards.

name: Rust en Vrede (Durbanville satellite)
about: A representative entry for the small additional Durbanville valley producers contributing fruit to the region's collective Sauvignon Blanc reputation.

name: Paul Clüver Family Wines
about: The founding estate of the Elgin Wine of Origin, where Dr. Paul Clüver planted the valley's first commercial vineyards in 1986. A fourth-generation family farm pioneering cool-climate Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Riesling.

name: Oak Valley Estate
about: Founded in 1898 by Sir Antonie Viljoen, a pioneering Elgin farm. Serious commercial vineyards were planted from 1998, producing acclaimed Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.

name: Almenkerk Wine Estate
about: Founded in 2004 by the Belgian Van Almenkerk family who converted a 36-hectare apple farm into a wine estate. Produces elegant Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Viognier.

name: Iona Vineyards
about: Founded in 1997 by Andrew Gunn on a 420m-altitude apple farm, the highest winery in Elgin and among the coolest vineyards in South Africa. Renowned for precise Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay.

name: Elgin Ridge
about: Founded in 2007 by Brian and Marion Smith at 282m altitude, the valley's only certified organic and biodynamic estate. Produces Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc.

name: Charles Fox Cap Classique
about: Founded in 2005 when Charles and Zelda Fox purchased the Furneaux fruit farm, specialising entirely in Méthode Cap Classique sparkling wines. Maiden Cap Classique released in 2012.

name: Richard Kershaw Wines
about: Founded in 2012 by UK-born Master of Wine Richard Kershaw, one of the few MWs to make his own wine. Specialises in clonally-selected cool-climate Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Syrah.

name: Shannon Vineyards
famous_for: Bordeaux reds; Chardonnay; Mount Bullet Merlot
about: Owned and run by brothers James and Stuart Downes on cool mountain hillside vineyards. Renowned for Bordeaux-style reds, especially the flagship Mount Bullet Merlot.

name: South Hill Vineyards
about: Purchased in 2001 by a consortium of businessmen, a boutique Elgin estate producing Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir with a popular restaurant and villa.

name: Highlands Road Estate
about: Founded in 2004 when Michael White converted an aging apple farm into a wine estate. First wine in 2007; produces Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc and other cool-climate varieties.

name: Hannay Wines
about: A rural Elgin family wine farm producing small-batch cool-climate whites and reds from estate vineyards.

name: Lothian Vineyards
about: A Wilson family estate on the Palmiet River in Grabouw, with Scottish heritage and three generations of Cape winemakers. Produces Bordeaux-style reds and Chardonnay.

name: Belfield Wine Estate
about: A small Elgin estate producing Sauvignon Blanc and Merlot from cool-climate vineyards on the valley floor.

name: William Everson Wines
about: A small family-owned garagiste winery in Elgin run by William Everson, who also produces the cult Everson's Cider. Elsenburg-trained, focused on small-batch Elgin expressions.

name: Spioenkop Wines
about: A Belgian-owned family estate founded in 2008 when Koen Roose and family acquired a hillside Elgin farm. Produces precise Chenin Blanc, Riesling and Pinot Noir.

name: Oneiric Wines
about: The Pascall family's boutique Elgin farm, in their ownership since 2007. Produces small-batch cool-climate wines including Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.

name: Elgin Vintners
about: A guild of Elgin growers pooling premium cool-climate fruit, founded in 2002. Produces Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Rhône-style reds from a co-operative cellar.

name: Corder Family Wines
about: The Corder family's Elgin estate, producing cool-climate wines inspired by New Zealand-style Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir.

name: Thandi Wines
about: A pioneering Fairtrade-accredited Elgin producer, the first wine brand to be Fairtrade certified worldwide. Sourcing from Elgin farm workers' vineyards.

name: Beaumont Family Wines
about: Founded by Raoul and Jayne Beaumont in 1974 and now run by son Sebastian. Set on the historic Compagnes Drift farm with the region's oldest cellar, famous for Pinotage and Chenin Blanc.

name: Gabriëlskloof
famous_for: Magdalena Chenin Blanc; Sauvignon Blanc; olive oil
about: Founded by Bernhard Heyns in 2001 on former wheat fields, with cellar opened to the public in 2009. Renowned for elegant Chenin Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc and estate olive oil.

name: Luddite Wines
about: Founded in November 1999 by Niels and Penny Verburg on the eastern slopes of the Houw Hoek Mountains. A small family winery dedicated to world-class Swartland-style Shiraz.

name: Barton Vineyards
about: The Neill family purchased Barton in 2001 and expanded plantings from 2003. A 500-acre farm producing wines and olives alongside a Fynbos Reserve.

name: Wildekrans Wine Estate
about: A mixed-farming operation converted into an award-winning estate, releasing its first wines in 1993. Now produces internationally acclaimed reds and whites on the Bot River hills.

name: Genevieve MCC
famous_for: Méthode Cap Classique; Blanc de Blancs
about: Founded in 2008 by first-generation winemaker Melissa Genevieve Nelsen at Klein Botrivier Farm. Specialises in Méthode Cap Classique Blanc de Blancs from Chardonnay.

name: Rivendell Wine Estate
about: A family-run Bot River estate producing boutique reds and Pinotage with a popular restaurant and sweeping valley views.

name: Villion Family Wines
about: The Villion family's small Bot River cellar producing limited-batch Chenin Blanc, Shiraz and other Mediterranean varieties.

name: Arcangeli Wines
about: A Bot River estate with Italian heritage producing Sangiovese, Barbera and other Italian varieties alongside a popular farm restaurant.

name: PaardenKloof
about: A biodiversity-focused Bot River estate in a stewardship reserve, producing estate-grown Sangiovese and Pinotage from cool-climate vineyards.

name: Anysbos
about: A small natural-wine Bot River producer crafting low-intervention Chenin Blanc and Mourvèdre-driven reds.

name: Maremmana
about: A boutique Bot River estate producing Italian-variety wines and farm-reared produce from the estate.

name: Escape Wines
about: A relaxed Bot River micro-cellar producing small-batch Rhône-style reds and Chenin Blanc with informal tastings.

name: Goedvertrouw Wine Estate
about: A small family Bot River farm producing limited boutique Chenin Blanc and other estate wines.

name: Feiteiras Wines
about: A small Bot River label with Madeiran roots producing Portuguese-variety wines from estate vines.

name: Strandveld Vineyards
about: The southernmost winery on the African continent, situated 9 km from the sea between Elim and Cape Agulhas. Produces wind-swept cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc, Syrah and the First Sighting range.

name: Black Oystercatcher
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; Pinot Noir; farm restaurant
about: A family-run wine farm at the cool southernmost tip of Africa, named after the endangered coastal bird. Produces distinctive cool-climate wines with a popular restaurant and cottages.

name: The Berrio
about: An Elim ward producer with vines planted from 1998, closely tied to early winemaker Bruce Jack and Francis Pratt. Produces elegant cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc and reds.

name: Zoetendal Vineyards
about: One of the first commercial vineyards on the Agulhas Plain, planting 15 ha in 1996, with a boutique cellar since 2004. Located on the Nuwejaars River near Elim.

name: Lomond Wine Estate
about: Situated on the Agulhas Plain near Gansbaai, with vines planted from 1999. Produces elegant single-vineyard Sauvignon Blanc and Syrah named after the area's flora.

name: Quoin Rock
about: A two-region producer with a Stellenbosch estate and Cape Agulhas vineyards at Quoin Point, established in 1998. Produces cool-climate wines from the southern Overberg.

name: Ghost Corner
about: David Nieuwoudt's (Cederberg) Elim-sourced label, drawing fruit from the cool, windswept Elim ward for premium Sauvignon Blanc and Semillon.

name: Land's End
about: One of the first two commercial Elim vineyards, planting vines in 1996. A source vineyard for several premium southern Cape Sauvignon Blanc labels.

name: Stars in the Dark
about: A small Elim-based producer crafting low-intervention wines from the windswept southern vineyards of the Elim ward.

name: The Drift Farm (Bruce Jack)
famous_for: Elim Sauvignon Blanc; Bruce Jack wines
about: Bruce Jack's estate in Napier in the Overberg Highlands, a founding member of the Agulhas Wine Triangle. Sources cool Elim fruit for a range of wines.

name: Sijnn Wines
famous_for: Syrah; Touriga Nacional; southern Cape reds
about: Founded in 2000 by David and Rita Trafford at Malgas near the mouth of the Breede River. An Agulhas Wine Triangle member producing low-yielding, terroir-driven reds and whites.

name: Jean Daneel Wines
about: A boutique cellar near Napier and Elim established by veteran winemaker Jean Daneel, producing handcrafted Chenin Blanc and Pinotage.

name: Darling Cellars
famous_for: old-vine Chenin Blanc; Shiraz; Sauvignon Blanc
about: Founded in 1997 as a privately owned winery on the West Coast, a co-operative of around 20 shareholders cultivating roughly 1,300 ha. Known for old-vine Chenin Blanc, Shiraz and dryland Sauvignon Blanc.

name: Groote Post Vineyards
famous_for: Sauvignon Blanc; MCC; The Old Man's Blend
about: A historic 18th-century estate revived for winemaking in 1995, run by the Pentz family. Produces acclaimed Sauvignon Blanc, a popular MCC and The Old Man's Blend with farm-to-table dining.

name: Ormonde Wine Estate
about: Owned by the Basson family since 1970, an estate on Darling's west coast slopes producing Pinotage, Sauvignon Blanc and single-vineyard bottlings. Tasting room in the town of Darling.

name: Cloof Wine Estate
famous_for: Darling Cellars; The Dark Side Shiraz; biodynamic
about: Vines date back to 1966 on this historic Darling farm. Now biodynamic-certified, producing bold reds including The Dark Side Shiraz. Tastings by appointment.

name: Contreberg Wine Farm
famous_for: Darling Hills Chenin Blanc; Sauvignon Blanc
about: A working farm in the Darling Hills with origins in the early 1800s, refocused on wine in the 1990s. Crafting Atlantic-breeze Chenin Blanc and Sauvignon Blanc, by appointment only.

name: Tukulu
about: A Black Economic Empowerment wine brand historically associated with Darling vineyards, producing Pinotage and Chenin Blanc from the region.

name: Murray's Vineyards
about: A Darling grower of premium Groenekloof Sauvignon Blanc and Chenin Blanc fruit, supplying several leading negociant producers.

name: Brakfontein
about: A smaller Darling district farm producing limited-volume boutique wines from dryland, cool-climate vineyards.

name: Alexfontein
about: A Darling district source farm of prized old-vine Chenin Blanc and Grenache fruit, used by several independent producers.

name: Klipheuwel (Darling)
about: A Darling hills vineyard source supplying cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc fruit to co-operative and negociant cellars.

name: Saronsberg Cellar
famous_for: Protea red blend; Shiraz; full-bodied reds
about: Founded by Nick van Huyssteen in 2002 on portions of the historic Twee Jonge Gezellen farm. Produces Tulbagh's benchmark full-bodied reds under winemaker Dewaldt Heyns, led by the Protea blend.

name: Rijk's Wine Estate
about: Established in 1996 by the Dorrington family and named after Rijk Tulbagh, an 18th-century Cape governor. A family-owned estate celebrated for Chenin Blanc, Pinotage and an acclaimed restaurant.

name: Twee Jonge Gezellen (House of Krone)
about: A 300-year-old estate and the historic home of Krone Cap Classique. The Krone family produce vintage-only Méthode Cap Classique sparkling wines from chalk-rich Tulbagh soils.

name: Theuniskraal Wine Estate
about: One of South Africa's oldest white-wine estates, with the first estate Riesling released in 1948. Famous as the first SA white wine to bear the word 'estate' on its label.

name: Lemberg Wine Estate
about: Established in 1978 by celebrated winemaker Janey Muller and once the smallest winery in South Africa. A 21-hectare boutique family estate run by the McNaught family, renowned for Sauvignon Blanc and rare Hárslevelü.

name: Manley Wine Estate
about: Established in 1996 by David Manley Jordan, a boutique estate 1.9 km outside Tulbagh. Produces Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz and Rhône-style reds with a guesthouse and dining.

name: Tulbagh Winery
about: Founded in 1906, one of the oldest co-operative cellars in South Africa. Produces widely-distributed, value-driven Tulbagh wines, fortifieds and brandy.

name: Waverley Hills Organic Wine & Olive Estate
about: A certified organic estate between Tulbagh and Ceres, near Wolseley, with first organic vineyards in 2000 and a cellar built in 2006. Produces organic wines, olives and Cap Classique.

name: Schalkenbosch Wine Estate
about: A historic estate established in the late 1700s with a 1792 Cape Dutch homestead (a national monument). First wine bottled under the Schalkenbosch label in 2002.

name: Montpellier de Tulbagh
about: Established in 1714 by Huguenot settlers and named after Montpellier, France. A boutique Tulbagh estate producing Shiraz, Bordeaux-style reds and Chardonnay with a restaurant.

name: Oudekloof Wine Estate
about: Named after the historic Oudekloof Pass and cultivated for nearly 300 years, producing estate Shiraz and old-vine reds on the slopes above Tulbagh.

name: Blue Crane Vineyards
about: Purchased and named by Fred and Manuela Crabbia in 2008, a boutique Tulbagh estate producing reds and whites with a guesthouse.

name: Oude Compagnies Post
about: Originally a buite-pos (outpost) of the Dutch East India Company, now a serene vineyard estate and home of Swanepoel Wines, producing estate Chenin Blanc and reds.

name: Drie Fonteine
about: A historic Tulbagh farm producing small-batch estate wines from heritage vineyards on the valley floor.

name: Cradock's Peak (Wolseley / Tulbagh fringes)
about: A representative entry for the additional small grower estates around the Tulbagh basin producing limited-volume valley wines.

name: Cederberg Private Cellar
famous_for: High Altitude Sauvignon Blanc; Ghost Corner; Bukettraube
about: South Africa's highest winery at over 1,000m on the Dwarsrivier farm in the Cederberg ward, led by winemaker David Nieuwoudt. The only wine farm in the Cederberg ward, producing acclaimed high-altitude wines.

name: Lutzville Vineyards
about: Established in 1962 on the lower Olifants River near the Atlantic coast, one of South Africa's largest cellars. Produces widely-distributed value wines from fertile valley vineyards.

name: Namaqua Wines
about: Formed from the 2002 amalgamation of the Vredendal (1947) and Spruitdrift cellars, the largest winery in the Olifants River region. Produces widely-distributed value wines.

name: Klawer Wine Cellars
about: A long-standing Olifants River co-operative cellar in the town of Klawer, producing accessible Chenin Blanc, Colombar and blended wines.

name: Piekenierskloof Wines
about: Originally the Citrusdal Cooperative Winery founded in 1957, renamed in 2007 under Charles Back. Home to some of South Africa's oldest Grenache and Chenin vines, some planted in 1962.

name: Sir Lambert
about: A premium estate label from the Cederberg family, producing site-specific wines from the windswept Bamboes Bay vineyard near the Atlantic coast.

name: Bamboes Bay
about: A sought-after coastal ward vineyard near Bamboes Bay, a source of prized cool-climate Sauvignon Blanc fruit used by several premium producers.

name: Tierhoek (Olifants)
about: A Piekenierskloof ward estate vineyard producing high-quality old-vine Grenache and Chenin Blanc fruit for the Olifants River estate tier.

name: Bosman Family Vineyards
about: Eight generations on the Lelienfontein farm (Wellington) since 1810, with Olifants River vineyard interests. Renowned for old-vine Grenache and a leading vine nursery business.

name: Wilgenhof Estate
about: A small family-run Olifants River estate producing boutique wines from valley vineyards.

name: Adoro Wines
about: A small Olifants River-focused label founded in 2004, producing old-vine blends and dessert wines (some sources list it as closed).

name: Vredendal Cellar
about: The historic Vredendal co-operative cellar founded in 1947, now amalgamated into Namaqua Wines but retaining its brand identity for certain lines.

name: Spruitdrift Cellar
about: The Spruitdrift co-operative cellar, merged with Vredendal in 2002 to form Namaqua Wines. One of the largest cellars in the region.

name: Citrusdal Valley Cellar
about: A grower co-operative cellar in the Citrusdal Valley district producing accessible, value-driven wines from valley-floor vineyards.

name: Donkiesbaai
about: A small premium label sourcing old-vine Piekenierskloof fruit for handcrafted Chenin Blanc and Sauvignon Blanc, cited as one of the area's best boutique producers.

name: Deetlefs Estate
about: The second-oldest family-owned wine estate in South Africa, steeped in seven generations of history since 1822. Run by the Deetlefs family and known for distinctive Pinotage and heritage bottlings.

name: Merwida Winery
famous_for: Chenin Blanc; Sauvignon Blanc; wetland conservation
about: One of the largest privately-owned vineyards in South Africa, nurtured by the Van der Merwe family for seven generations since 1844. Also recognised for conserving 600 hectares of wetlands; dining at Cecile's Tea Room.

name: Daschbosch
about: A boutique label of the UniWines group on a farm dating to 1754, focused on elegant wines from old vines and heritage fruit. Hosts pop-up tasting events.

name: Opstal Estate
famous_for: Carl Everson Chenin Blanc; single-vineyard wines
about: A seventh-generation family farm dating back to 1847, celebrated for its single-vineyard wines including the Carl Everson Chenin Blanc. Features a country restaurant and self-catering accommodation.

name: Slanghoek Cellar
about: Established in 1951, a co-operative cellar situated 800m above sea level in a mountain amphitheatre in the Slanghoek Valley. Strong affinity for Chenin Blanc, with cellar tours, pairings and a mountain-bike route.

name: Jason's Hill Private Cellar
about: Operated by the Du Toit family since 1844 and established as a private cellar in 2002 by award-winning female winemaker Ivy du Toit. Offers private tastings and a waterfall hiking trail.

name: Bergsig Wine Estate
about: Owned by the Lategan family since 1843, an estate offering balanced wines, a bistro and a renovated farm cottage. A birdwatching and mountain-biking destination on the Bergsig Trail.

name: Badsberg Wine Cellar
famous_for: premium whites; sweet wines; General Smuts Trophy
about: Founded in 1951 at the foot of the Badsberg Mountains, a co-op renowned for premium white and sweet wines, having won the coveted General Smuts Trophy four times. Offers tastings and cheese platters overlooking the valley.

name: Belle Rebelle Winery
about: A boutique label sourcing grapes from ancestral family vineyards, specialising in sparkling wines like its CapeSecco. Also home to a gin distillery and the Ou Stokery restaurant.

name: Du Toitskloof Wines
about: A Breedekloof valley co-operative cellar focusing on traditional French blends under its Quest label. Features a bustling tasting venue with art, mimosas, pop-up bars and an adjacent bakery.

name: Mountain Ridge Wines
about: Established as a winery in 1949 near Wolseley, producing both boutique and large-volume wines. Acclaimed for its Romansrivier Chenin Blanc, with a tasting room and events venue.

name: Breëland Estate
about: Owned by the Marais family since the early 1840s, with a winemaker favouring cold macerations and slow ferments. Features a newly built tasting room, self-catering cottage and outdoor trails.

name: Botha Kelder
famous_for: Amyah and Turoc Unify boutique labels
about: Formed in 1949, a large co-operative of 35 farms near Worcester. Known for premium boutique bottlings under the Amyah and Turoc Unify labels, offering tastings, pairings and cheese platters.

name: Olifantsberg Wines
about: Located on rocky mountain slopes near Worcester, focused on site-specific, unique wines. Its dedication to site earned its winemaker a Young Winemaker of the Year award. Tastings by appointment.

name: Kirabo Kompanjie
about: A family-owned boutique label specialising in Petit Verdot and unique culinary pairings such as red-wine-infused cupcakes. Also houses a craft brewery and a popular wedding venue.

name: De Wetshof Estate
about: Robertson's first registered wine estate, established by Danie de Wet. Known as the 'House of Chardonnay' for its limestone-driven single-vineyard Chardonnays.

name: Springfield Estate
about: Fourth-generation Bruwer family estate producing terroir-driven wines like Whole Berry and Life from Stone from mineral-rich Robertson soils.

name: Van Loveren Family Vineyards
about: One of South Africa's most visited family wineries, owned by the Retief family since 1937. Known for its River Red Muscadel and extensive gardens.

name: Graham Beck Wines
about: Founded by Graham Beck, one of the pioneers of Méthode Cap Classique. The Robertson estate supplies premium fruit for sparkling and still wines.

name: Robertson Winery
about: One of the largest co-operatives in the valley, founded 1941, producing a broad range from 35 member farms along the Breede River.

name: Viljoensdrift
about: Family-run estate on the banks of the Breede River, known for its food-and-wine pairing and picnics along the riverbank.

name: Weltevrede Wine Estate
about: A three-generation family estate specializing in Chardonnay, with a focus on soil-driven single-vineyard bottlings.

name: Excelsior Wine Estate
about: Historic estate owned by the de Wet family, known for approachable, well-priced reds and whites from the Breede River Valley.

name: Rietvallei Wine Estate
about: Family-owned estate established 1864, home to some of South Africa's oldest vines, including 1908 Muscadel used in fortified wines.

name: Bon Courage Estate
about: Family estate owned by the Bruwer family, producing an unusually wide range including a noted Jacques Bruère Brut MCC.

name: Zandvliet Wine Estate
about: Pioneer of Robertson Shiraz, also known for its on-site Klein Karoo horse stud and riverside tasting.

name: Silverthorn Wines
about: Boutique producer of Méthode Cap Classique, including the Genisis and River Grandeur bubbly lines, set on the Breede River.

name: Rooiberg Winery
about: Co-operative cellar established 1964, producing the well-known Rooiberg range and eco-friendly 'Buck Loaded' wines.

name: Graham Beck Robertson
about: Premium MCC-focused cellar established by Graham Beck, whose Brut is served at international state occasions.

name: Wolfkloof Wines
about: Family-run Robertson cellar known for weddings and a broad range of red and white cultivar wines.

name: Kleinhoekkloof Wines
about: Small boutique farm set in a kloof outside Robertson, producing low-volume estate wines from steep vineyards.

name: Rivergold Wine Estate
about: Family-run Robertson estate with river-frontage vineyards, known for easy-drinking wines and a family-friendly cellar door.

name: Arendsig Wine Estate
about: Boutique family farm between Bonnievale and Robertson producing hand-crafted single-vineyard wines and self-catering cottages.

name: Tanagra Winery & Distillery
about: Small estate outside McGregor producing Rhône-style wines, grappa and potstill brandies from estate fruit.

name: Fossil Hills
about: Family-owned farm near Robertson named for its fossil-rich soils, making small-batch natural-leaning wines.

name: Paul René MCC
about: Boutique Robertson cellar dedicated to traditional-method Cap Classique, founded by the René family.

name: Kranskop Wines
about: Family farm on the slopes of Kranskop hill producing estate-grown reds and whites with scenic valley views.

name: McGregor Winery
about: Co-operative-style cellar in the village of McGregor, the smallest ward in the Robertson district.

name: The Lab
about: A small experimental micro-winery and tasting room in Robertson exploring alternative blends and cultivars.

name: Bonnievale Wines
about: Co-operative formed by the merger of three Bonnievale cellars, making the Riverine and Cobblestone brands from 100 member farms.

name: Ashton Winery
about: Co-operative cellar at the gateway to Robertson Valley, producing wine, brandy and grape juice concentrates.

name: Roodezandt
about: Co-operative cellar based in Robertson, well known for its Muscadel and a broad portfolio of affordable everyday wines.

name: Marbrin Olive Farm
about: Specialist olive estate in Robertson that also crafts small-batch wines alongside its award-winning olive oils.

name: Viljoensdrift River Cruises
about: The tourism arm of Viljoensdrift offering Breede River cruises and riverside picnics paired with estate wines.

name: La Verne Wine Boutique
about: Wine boutique in Robertson town showcasing a curated selection of wines from the Robertson Wine Valley.

name: Cloverfield Estate
about: Family-run Robertson estate producing approachable white and red wines from limestone-rich soils.

name: Graham Beck Robertson Cellar
about: Flagship cellar of the Graham Beck portfolio, producing award-winning MCC and estate still wines.

name: Montagu Winery
about: Co-operative cellar on Route 62 in Montagu, known for Muscadel, fortified wines and brandy.

name: Bonnievale Cap Classique Cellar
about: Sparkling wine project of Bonnievale Wines, producing traditional-method MCC from Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.

name: Bergsig Estate
about: Family-owned estate in the Breede River Valley, known for aromatic whites, dessert wines and a popular on-site restaurant.

name: Overhex Wines
about: Export-focused cellar in Worcester, producers of the Survivor and Monterey brands and recipient of many international awards.

name: Nuy Winery
about: Co-operative cellar in the Nuy Valley, known for Muscadel and a wide range of red and white cultivars.

name: De Wet Cellars
about: The oldest cellar in the Worcester area, producing wine, potstill brandy and fortified styles from estate and grower fruit.

name: Aan De Doorns Wine Cellar
about: Co-operative cellar in the Hex River Valley known for fresh, aromatic whites and good-value everyday wines.

name: De Doorns Cellar
about: Co-operative cellar in the Hex River Valley producing high-volume everyday wines and dessert Muscadel.

name: Brandvlei Cellar
about: Worcester co-operative cellar near the Brandvlei Dam, known for fresh white wines and good-value reds.

name: Cilmor Winery
about: Producer cellar in Worcester making branded wines for export, including the Lion's Creek and Bijou Noir labels.

name: Eagle's Cliff
about: Small family cellar between Villiersdorp and Worcester, known for Chenin Blanc and traditional-method bubbly.

name: Stettyn Family Vineyards
about: Cellar in the Stettyn ward, dating back to the Botha family's 1714 farm, producing estate and single-vineyard wines.

name: Leipzig Country House & Winery
about: Nuy Valley boutique winery and guest house on Route 62, producing small-batch wines paired with country-style dining.

name: Groot Eiland Winery
about: Co-operative cellar on the Breede River near Worcester producing bulk and branded white wines.

name: Kleinplasie Wine Cellar
about: Worcester cellar attached to the Kleinplasie living museum, offering tastings and a farm-style restaurant.

name: KWV Worcester
about: Worcester production and maturation facility of KWV, the historic producer of brandy, fortified and still wines.

name: Noordboland Co-operative
about: Worcester-area co-operative cellar producing affordable everyday wines and grape concentrate.

name: Botha Cellar
about: Family cellar in the Stettyn ward, descendant of the historic 1714 Botha farm, producing varietal wines.

name: Daschbosch Cellar
about: Family-owned co-operative cellar near the Brandvlei Dam, crafting terroir-driven wines from old dryland vines.

name: Boplaas Family Vineyards
about: Six-generation Calitzdorp estate, distilling spirits since 1880 and renowned for Portuguese varieties and Cape Port-style wines.

name: De Krans Wines
about: Calitzdorp cellar on the Gamka River, the first in SA to bottle Touriga Nacional as a dry red, also known for Cape Ports.

name: Calitzdorp Cellars
about: Co-operative cellar founded 1928, best known for its sweet dessert wines and Gamka Valley views.

name: Axe Hill Winery
about: Boutique Calitzdorp cellar specialising in port-style wines using traditional Portuguese foot-treading techniques.

name: Peter Bayly Winery
about: Small Calitzdorp cellar in the Groenfontein Valley crafting premium Portuguese-style wines with natural fermentation.

name: Du'SwaRoo Wines
about: The smallest wine farm on the Klein Karoo wine route, producing limited boutique wines alongside deli items.

name: TTT Cellars
about: Boutique Calitzdorp winery on the R62 specialising in hand-crafted dry wines and unusual Portuguese blends.

name: Withoek Wine Farm
about: Boutique Calitzdorp cellar producing small quantities of Muscadel, Hanepoot and other fortified styles.

name: Karusa Wines
about: Oudtshoorn winery at the foot of the Swartberg combining wine production with a craft brewery and bistro.

name: Grundheim Wines
about: Family estate just outside Oudtshoorn, producing fortified Muscadel and potstill brandy alongside table wines.

name: Domein Doornkraal
about: Family farm at the foot of the Swartberg near Calitzdorp, producing Portuguese-style wines and a padstal.

name: Herold Wines
about: Cool-climate estate in the Herold ward between George and Oudtshoorn, specialising in Pinot Noir and Sauvignon Blanc.

name: Hillock Wines
about: Small Klein Karoo estate known for Muscadel and fortified wines from low-yielding vineyards.

name: Joseph Barry Distillery
about: Historic Ladismith distillery and cellar producing potstill brandy, fortified wines and table wines.

name: Joubert-Tradauw Private Cellar
about: Family boutique cellar in the Tradouw Valley near Barrydale, founded by Meyer Joubert after training in Napa.

name: Drie Berge Winery
about: Klein Karoo producer crafting small-batch wines from vineyards at the foot of three mountain peaks.

name: Rietrivier Winery
about: Co-operative cellar along the Riet River, producing affordable everyday wines and grape juice.

name: Excelsior Vlakteplaas
about: Family farm in the Klein Karoo producing hand-crafted wines from a single estate.

name: Surval Boutique Olive Estate
about: Olive and wine estate near the Cango Caves, offering olive tastings and a restaurant serving Klein Karoo wines.

name: Metanoia Distillery
about: Small distillery on the Op de Tradouw farm near Barrydale crafting gin, brandy and small-batch spirits.

name: Tahlia Distillery
about: Farm distillery in the Klein Karoo producing craft spirits and brandy alongside small-batch wines.

name: Excelsior Wine Estate (Klein Karoo)
about: Estate cellar in the Calitzdorp district producing approachable red blends from warm Klein Karoo vineyards.

name: Calitzdorp Wine Cellar Co-op
about: Co-operative cellar that defined Calitzdorp's reputation for fortified and sweet Muscadel wines.

name: Sumsare Wines
about: Family boutique in the Klein Karoo producing small-lot wines from old-vine fruit.

name: Bushmanspad Wine Estate
about: Route 62 estate producing bold Klein Karoo reds, particularly Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Arabella Wine Estate
about: Robertson-adjacent Route 62 estate crafting accessible reds and whites with a focus on Shiraz.

name: Burcon Wines
about: Small Route 62 cellar producing value-driven wines from estate vineyards.

name: Montagu Wines (Co-op)
about: Historic Montagu co-operative cellar on Route 62, one of the oldest in the region, known for fortified Muscadel.

name: Withoek-Surval
about: Boutique Klein Karoo cellar producing Hanepoot and other fortified wines from old bush vines.

name: Ladismith Cellar
about: Co-operative cellar in Ladismith producing table wines, brandy and fortified styles under the Towerkop label.

name: Orange River Cellars
about: Co-operative founded 1965, headquartered in Upington, sourcing from 160 grape producers along the Orange (Gariep) River.

name: Orange River Cellars - Groblershoop
about: One of the five production cellars of Orange River Cellars, based in Groblershoop in the Green Kalahari.

name: Orange River Cellars - Grootdrink
about: Production cellar of the Orange River Cellars co-operative located in the Grootdrink district.

name: Orange River Cellars - Keimoes
about: Keimoes production facility of Orange River Cellars, focused on white cultivars and dessert wines.

name: Orange River Cellars - Kakamas
about: Kakamas cellar of Orange River Cellars producing aromatic whites along the upper Orange River.

name: Douglas Wine Cellar
about: Co-operative cellar at the confluence of the Orange and Vaal Rivers, producing fresh white wines and brandy.

name: Sutherland Wine Estate
about: High-altitude Northern Cape estate experimenting with cool-climate varieties on the edge of the Karoo.

name: African Vineyard
about: Boutique estate near Upington offering wine tastings and accommodation along the Orange River.

name: Kalahari Wines
about: Brand produced in the Green Kalahari region, focusing on easy-drinking fruit-forward wines.

name: Lower Orange Wines
about: Northern Cape bulk-wine producer and exporter, sourcing fruit from lower Orange River vineyards.

name: Abingdon Wine Estate
about: The first certified wine estate in KwaZulu-Natal, located at Lion's River in the Midlands, producing cool-climate estate wines.

name: Highgate Wine Estate
about: Family estate in the heart of the KZN Midlands crafting 100% estate-bottled wines with a restaurant and event venue.

name: Cathedral Peak Wine Estate
about: The only wine estate deep in the Drakensberg mountains, set beneath Cathedral, Cathkin and Monk's Cowl peaks.

name: Stables Wine Estate
about: One of KZN's early wineries, established on a former racehorse stud in the Midlands, producing estate and fortified wines.

name: Tiny Zinyole Wine Estate
about: Small family-owned KZN winery in the Midlands producing hand-crafted boutique reds and whites.

name: Richardson Wines
about: Long-established Eastern Cape wine producer based in Stutterheim, specialising in fortified wines and brandy.

name: Pirie Wine Estate
about: Small Eastern Cape cellar near Stutterheim, one of the few commercial wineries in the province, producing table wines.

name: Makana Meadery
about: Grahamstown (Makhanda)-based meadery producing traditional Xhosa iQhilika honey mead and fruit wines.

name: Hogsback Brewing & Wine
about: Small Hogsback operation producing craft cider alongside small-batch fruit and grape wines.

name: Eastern Cape Wine Cellar
about: Port Elizabeth-area producer and bottler of Eastern Cape fortified wines and table wines.

name: Gerakaris Family Wines
about: Johannesburg's first urban winery, in Craighall Park, making wine from grapes trucked from Swartland and Elgin.

name: Kievits Kroon Wine Estate
about: Country-house wine estate near Pretoria offering accommodation, fine dining and a cellar of Western Cape wines.

name: The Tasting Room Pretoria
about: Waterkloof-based tasting venue in Pretoria showcasing a curated selection of South African wines.

name: VDP Distributors Gauteng
about: Gauteng-based distributor and bottler of an exclusive selection of South African wine farm labels.

name: Cape Wine Vault Johannesburg
about: Urban wine cellar and tasting lounge in Johannesburg featuring Western Cape wines and small-batch bottlings.

name: Graceland Wine Estate
about: Boutique estate near Bloemfontein producing small-batch wines from grapes sourced in the Western Cape.

name: Welvanpas Country Estate
about: Country estate near Magaliesberg offering wine tastings of Western Cape wines alongside dining and accommodation.

name: Matlapeng Wine Estate
about: Boutique wine operation in the North West province crafting small-lot wines from bought-in Western Cape fruit.

name: Riba Vineyards
about: Experimental Limpopo vineyard trialling heat-tolerant cultivars and producing small-batch wines.

name: Tzaneen Wine Cellar
about: Small Tzaneen-based cellar producing boutique whites from bought-in cool-climate fruit.

name: Blank Bottle
about: Pieter Walser's irreverent négociant label producing 40+ small-lot wines from grapes bought across ~60 vineyards, with labels that famously omit grape variety.

name: Momento Wines
about: Marelise Niemann's sourced-fruit label from Bot River and Swartland, run on a European-style négociant-grower model.

name: Thorne & Daughters
about: John and Tasha Seccombe's négociant label producing fine Cape white blends from ~15 contracted growers across Bot River and Voor-Paardeberg.

name: TSW (Trizanne Signature Wines)
about: Trizanne Barnard's ocean-inspired négociant project contrasting cool Elim whites with warm Swartland reds.

name: Blackwater Wine
about: François's sourced-fruit label focused on building long-term grower relationships across the Western Cape for light, elegant reds.

name: Paserene Wines
about: Martin Smith and Ndavhe Mareda's boutique label, mostly a négociant operation sourcing Chardonnay from Elgin and reds from Tulbagh.

name: The Winery of Good Hope
about: Alex Dale and Ben Radford's négociant-style range sourcing fruit from Stellenbosch, Swartland and Elgin across several labels.

name: Radford Dale
about: Alex Dale and Ben Radford's refined estate-and-sourced label from Stellenbosch and the Helderberg, established 1998.

name: Thistle & Weed
about: Terblanche and Wiid family collaboration sourcing fruit from selected Stellenbosch vineyards, with each wine named for a weed.

name: Crystallum Wines
about: Peter-Allan and Andrew Finlayson's family-run label sourcing Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from cool Hemel-en-Aarde sites.

name: Rock of Eye
about: Coenie Snyman's négociant label that owns no vineyards, sourcing all fruit from long-standing Stellenbosch partners.

name: Harry Hartman
about: Self-described 'wine without vines' négociant sourcing fruit from Western Cape growers to make accessible blends.

name: Alinea Wines
about: Natasha Jacka's boutique label launched during lockdown, producing five wines from grapes sourced from vineyards around Cape Town.

name: Fable Wines
about: Western Cape négociant-style winery producing small-batch blends from selected grower fruit.

name: Joubert-Tradauw R62
about: Meyer Joubert's R62 range, a sourced and estate-fruit line of Chardonnay and Chenin Blanc blends from the Tradouw Valley.

name: David & Nadia
about: David and Nadia Sadie's sourced-fruit label making 100% Swartland, dry-farmed bush-vine wines from Paardebosch Farm.

name: AA Badenhorst
about: Adi Badenhorst's Kalmoesfontein estate on the Paardeberg, also producing sourced-fruit Secateurs and Family Wines labels.

name: Craven Wines
about: Mick and Janine Craven's sourced-fruit label crafting site-specific Syrah, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir from across the Cape.

name: Savage Wines
about: Duncan Savage's sourced-fruit label producing Syrah and Chenin-led blends from carefully selected Cape vineyards.

name: Mullineux Old Vines
about: Mullineux's sourced-fruit old-vine Chenin Blanc and Syrah bottlings from across the Swartland.

name: Vondeling Wines
about: Boutique estate on the foothills of the Voor-Paardeberg with ~40 ha of own vines dating back to 1704.

name: Fryer's Cove
about: The only vineyard in Bamboes Bay, South Africa's smallest ward, producing precise cool-climate wines at Doringbaai.

name: Radford Dale Africana
about: Sourced-fruit Rhône-style label from the Radford Dale stable, crafting Syrah and Chenin Blanc from Swartland growers.

name: Intellectual Property Wines
about: Concept-driven négociant label sourcing fruit from across the Cape for irreverently named small-batch wines.

name: Le Lude Wines
about: Boutique Stellenbosch cellar and restaurant focused on traditional-method Cap Classique, using estate and sourced fruit.

name: Raats Family Wines
about: Bruwer Rafts' specialist Chenin Blanc and Cabernet Franc estate on the Helderberg, with some sourced-fruit single-vineyard bottlings.

name: Ken Forrester Wines
about: 'Mr Chenin' Ken Forrester's estate on 38 ha in Stellenbosch, also buying in grapes for entry-level boutique labels.

name: Edgebaston
about: David Finlayson's sourced-fruit Stellenbosch label built from scratch, producing Bordeaux-style reds and Chardonnay.

name: Bruwer Raats sourced labels
about: Raats' sourced-fruit single-vineyard Chenin Blanc bottlings from across Stellenbosch and the Cape Winelands.

name: Vondeling Babylons Toren
about: Vondeling's flagship sourced-fruit Rhône-style blend from older Voor-Paardeberg vineyards.

name: Boekenhoutskloof sourced lines
about: Boekenhoutskloof's sourced-fruit everyday label, Porcupine Ridge, drawing on growers across the Western Cape.

name: Waverley Hills Organic Wine
about: Certified-organic estate in the Tulbagh Valley established 2000, producing 100% organic estate wines and olive oil.

name: Mosi Wines
about: Joseph Dhafana's black-owned négociant label sourcing fruit from Western Cape growers for accessible Chenin and Pinotage.

name: Nice Beverage Co.
about: Black-owned négociant brand sourcing fruit from the Western Cape to make accessible canned and bottled wines.

name: The Garajeest
about: Independent award-winning Cape Town garagiste producer making small-lot sourced-fruit wines.

name: Rüdger van Wyk Wines
about: Leading new-wave South African winemaker crafting sourced-fruit boutique reds from cool-climate sites.

name: Forrester Meinert Sourced
about: Ken Forrester and Martin Meinert's sourced-fruit collaboration, best known for the Tetelestai red blend.

name: Stellekaya
about: Stellenbosch cellar producing estate and sourced-fruit wines, with winemaker Rose Kruger, including a Cabernet line.

name: Fables Mountain Vineyards
about: Tulbagh estate with hands-on winemaking, also drawing on sourced fruit for its Rhône-style wines.
